observations.why: 'We're switching' performs a settled, load-bearing commitment — ratification language indicating the decision is already made and being acted on.
Flat unhedged assertions presented as justification for the switch — asserted and defensible, but no ratification or performed settling; claim-level.
Xena records the migration as a settled item in a decision summary — performed declarative ratifying the switch as decided.
Restated performance claim in summary form — asserted as fact but not ratified or performed; claim-level.
A fixed timeline attached to the migration summary ratifies the decision as load-bearing and operational — the speaker commits others to a concrete date.
